findings.title: zip(error_ids, events.values()) does not guarantee correct ID-to-data mapping
findings.body: In `fetch_error_details`, `nodestore.backend.get_multi(node_ids)` returns a dict keyed by node_id. Using `zip(error_ids, events.values())` assumes the dict values are returned in the same order as the requested `error_ids`, but dict ordering depends on the internal implementation of `get_multi` and is not guaranteed to match the request order. This can silently associate error titles/messages with the wrong error IDs. The correct approach is to iterate over `node_ids` and look up each key individually: `for node_id, event_id in zip(node_ids, error_ids): data = events.get(node_id)`.

findings.title: Mutual exclusion validation for age/timestamp uses truthiness instead of key presence
findings.body: `validate_timestamp` checks `self.initial_data.get("age")` and `validate_age` checks `self.initial_data.get("timestamp")`. These are truthiness checks, so if `age` is 0 or `timestamp` is 0 (both valid values per the field definitions), the mutual exclusion validation is silently bypassed. A report with both `age: 0` and `timestamp: 123` would pass validation despite violating the spec's constraint that only one may be present. The checks should use `"age" in self.initial_data` and `"timestamp" in self.initial_data` respectively.

findings.title: Feature-flagged TableWidgetVisualization renders hardcoded empty data, discarding actual query results
findings.body: When the `use-table-widget-visualization` feature flag is enabled, the code renders `<TableWidgetVisualization columns={[]} tableData={{data: [], meta: {fields: {}, units: {}}}} />`, completely ignoring the actual `result.data`, `result.meta`, `fields`, `fieldAliases`, and other props that are available in scope. Users with this feature flag enabled will see an empty table instead of their dashboard widget data. This appears to be unfinished placeholder code that should not be shipped behind a flag that could be enabled.

findings.title: Analytics event recorded before feature flag check, inflating metrics with rejected requests
findings.body: `analytics.record("preprod_artifact.api.assemble", ...)` is called unconditionally at the top of the `post` method, before the feature flag check on line 88. If the feature is not enabled, the request is rejected with a 404, but the analytics event has already been recorded. This inflates usage metrics with requests that were never actually served. The analytics call should be moved after the feature flag check.

findings.title: get_environment_info calls issue.get_recommended_event() which may trigger a database/nodestore query per issue
findings.body: `get_environment_info` is called for each issue in the PR comment list (inside a list comprehension in `get_comment_body`). `issue.get_recommended_event()` likely performs a database or nodestore lookup. For PRs with many associated issues, this results in N additional queries. Consider batching or caching this lookup, or at minimum ensuring it doesn't cause N+1 query problems in production.
